name: quillgeist-web
description: Give an authorized AI assistant live web search, page reading, and governed multi-step browser automation through Clintware and a paired local qq browser.

interface.shortDescription: Live web search, page reading, and governed qq browser automation.
interface.longDescription: Quillgeist Web combines the authenticated Clintware MCP control plane with the paired local qq Playwright browser. It provides semantic web search and page-reading tools plus bounded multi-step browser automation, curated safety rules, durable job evidence, manual local authentication, and OAuth/PKCE connection without asking the user to paste a Control Plane API key. The current alpha OAuth policy is owner/admin scoped.
defaultPrompt: Search the live web for this and return the strongest sources.
Read this page and extract the relevant facts and links.
Use my paired qq browser to complete these browser steps, stopping before any consequential action unless I explicitly approved it.
